claims: commitFiveElementInitiation: preflight region (L551-656) is write-free by inspection - every early return happens before the snapshot/commit boundary

commit region snapshots all three mutable channels: PlayerData (JSON clone), skillManager learned-set ids, techniqueManager list - restorePlayerSnapshotInPlace deletes+reassigns in snapshot key order (byte-equivalence proof in tests)

existing suite pins 5 mid-commit fault injections (starter learn fail, kit learn fail, element commit fail, realm-advance crash, technique grant fail) + retry-after-failure - all byte-equivalent at current state (9/9 green incl. ritual flow integration)

external escapes audited and closed: markQuestRealmTransition leaves a flag -> next-tick reconcile is idempotent+realm-checked; issueCompanionGifts writes only player.companionGifts (snapshot-covered); no eventBus emits in any leg; sessionRng never consumed (element root insightCost=0 -> rollVanDaoWaive short-circuits)

hostile injection surface: element validated by isBetaElement allow-list first; second call hits already_committed/element_committed/not_mortal; direct selectSpellPathElement outside ritual fails closed (mortal-only + static capability gate); in_combat guard at op + learnSkill leg level
caller coverage: QuanKhiPanel maps every FiveElementInitiationResult.reason to i18n with te() fallback; EarlyGameSession uses the same op
limitations: rollback does not (and cannot) restore the tick-ops questRealmReconcileNeeded flag - documented idempotent design; reconcile against the restored player is equivalent to a restore-time reconcile
the test suite injects faults at 5 named legs; a fault inside a finer-grained sub-step relies on the same snapshot mechanism (mechanism-level proof, not per-step enumeration)
